title: Majority maximizes signed sum
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. Write $M(x)=1$ if $\sum_{i=1}^n x_i\ge0$ and $M(x)=-1$ otherwise. Then $f(x)\sum_{i=1}^n x_i\le M(x)\sum_{i=1}^n x_i$.
